title: System parity: Flow Accounting + Proxy + Sysctl baseline pages
acceptance_criteria: Backend exposes scoped wrappers for `system flow-accounting`, `system proxy`, and `system sysctl` without replacing existing service layers.
System pages exist for `/system/flow-accounting`, `/system/proxy`, and `/system/sysctl` with form-first CRUD workflows.
System navigation and coverage links surface all three pages, and runtime smoke probes include them.
Validation gates pass: backend tests, frontend typecheck, targeted eslint, frontend build, and runtime smoke.
assumptions: Some advanced leaves for these system trees are platform/version specific and will be completed in a follow-up option-depth pass.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked on this host due missing `libnspr4.so`.

tasks.notes: Implemented scoped wrapper and form-first Flow Accounting page with interface, NetFlow, and sFlow controls.
Implemented scoped wrapper and form-first System Proxy page with URL/port/auth/no-proxy controls.
Implemented scoped wrapper and form-first Sysctl parameter CRUD page.
Added IA links, how-to guides, and smoke route coverage for the new System pages.
Next queue: SYS-01 Conntrack, SYS-02 Serial Console, SYS-03 Default Route/Gateway.
